assembly_mode: metadata only; no project command, proof, fuzz or benchmark execution

execution_policy.bounded_pair: one Kani harness job plus one QEMU test process; original proof budgets unchanged
execution_policy.later_pair: at most two independent non-timing jobs, separate targets, immutable existing sysroots
execution_policy.timing_scope: recorded command wall time is operational evidence, not a benchmark; custom row sums exclude setup
execution_policy.snapshots: retain original acquisition-time policy text; later concurrency approvals are scoped separately

report_status: 46 required rows passed, including the independent package row; two added full-width stages unverified; four native Windows rows unavailable; three optional diagnostics separate

new_workflow_epoch.workflow_yaml:
name: Verification

on:
  push:
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      experimental_proofs:
        description: Run retained open Kani obligations (currently expected to fail)
        type: boolean
        default: false
      extended_miri:
        description: Run every known unsupported SIMD shim probe (currently expected to fail)
        type: boolean
        default: false

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

defaults:
  run:
    shell: bash

jobs:
  tests:
    env:
      PROPTEST_CASES: '512'
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest, windows-latest]
        profile:
          - { name: debug, args: '' }
          - { name: release, args: '--release' }
        caches:
          - { name: 'off', features: '__internals', public_args: '' }
          - { name: 'on', features: '__internals,cache', public_args: '--features cache' }
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - run: rustup update stable --no-self-update
      - run: rustc +stable -vV
      - name: Unit, API, and property tests
        run: cargo +stable test --locked --features ${{ matrix.caches.features }} --lib --tests ${{ matrix.profile.args }}
      - name: Public API without internal exports
        run: cargo +stable test --locked --test api --test no_alloc --test tiny_inputs --test public_properties --test bitcoin_core --test owned_output ${{ matrix.caches.public_args }} ${{ matrix.profile.args }}
      - name: Downstream API and internal namespace boundaries
        if: matrix.profile.name == 'debug' && matrix.caches.name == 'off'
        env:
          RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN: stable
        run: python3 scripts/check_public_api.py --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/base58-api-namespace"
      - name: Documentation examples
        run: cargo +stable test --locked --doc ${{ matrix.caches.public_args }} ${{ matrix.profile.args }}
      - name: Compile every benchmark
        run: cargo +stable build --locked --features ${{ matrix.caches.features }} --benches ${{ matrix.profile.args }}

  compact:
    env:
      PROPTEST_CASES: '512'
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest]
        caches:
          - { name: 'off', features: '__internals,compact', public_args: '--features compact' }
          - { name: 'on', features: '__internals,cache,compact', public_args: '--features cache,compact' }
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - run: rustup update stable --no-self-update
      - run: cargo +stable test --locked --features ${{ matrix.caches.features }} --lib --tests
      - run: cargo +stable test --locked --features ${{ matrix.caches.features }} --lib --tests --release
      - run: cargo +stable test --locked --test api --test no_alloc --test tiny_inputs --test public_properties --test bitcoin_core --test owned_output ${{ matrix.caches.public_args }}
      - run: cargo +stable test --locked --test api --test no_alloc --test tiny_inputs --test public_properties --test bitcoin_core --test owned_output ${{ matrix.caches.public_args }} --release
      - run: cargo +stable test --locked --doc ${{ matrix.caches.public_args }}
      - run: cargo +stable build --locked --release --features ${{ matrix.caches.features }} --benches

  alternate_limb_width:
    env:
      PROPTEST_CASES: '512'
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - run: rustup update stable --no-self-update
      - run: cargo +stable test --locked --lib --tests --features __internals,malachite-nz/32_bit_limbs
      - run: cargo +stable test --locked --release --lib --tests --features __internals,malachite-nz/32_bit_limbs

  portable_builds:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        target: [wasm32-unknown-unknown, aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu]
        profile:
          - { name: debug, args: '' }
          - { name: release, args: '--release' }
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - run: rustup target add --toolchain stable ${{ matrix.target }}
      - run: cargo +stable build --locked --lib --target ${{ matrix.target }} ${{ matrix.profile.args }}
      - run: cargo +stable build --locked --lib --features cache --target ${{ matrix.target }} ${{ matrix.profile.args }}
      - run: cargo +stable build --locked --lib --features __internals --target ${{ matrix.target }} ${{ matrix.profile.args }}
      - run: cargo +stable build --locked --lib --features __internals,cache --target ${{ matrix.target }} ${{ matrix.profile.args }}

  maximum_transform:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - run: |
          set -e -o pipefail
          cargo +stable test --locked --release --lib ntt::tests::largest_transforms -- --ignored --exact 2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/maximum-transform.log"
          grep -Eq '^test result: ok\. 1 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored;' "$RUNNER_TEMP/maximum-transform.log"

  no_std:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        target: [thumbv7em-none-eabi, x86_64-unknown-none]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - run: rustup target add --toolchain stable ${{ matrix.target }}
      - run: cargo +stable build --locked --lib --no-default-features --target ${{ matrix.target }}
      - run: cargo +stable build --locked --lib --no-default-features --features __internals --target ${{ matrix.target }}
      - run: cargo +stable build --locked --release --lib --no-default-features --target ${{ matrix.target }}
      - run: cargo +stable build --locked --release --lib --no-default-features --features __internals --target ${{ matrix.target }}

  msrv:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - run: rustup toolchain install 1.95 --profile minimal
      - run: cargo +1.95 build --locked --lib
      - run: cargo +1.95 build --locked --lib --features std
      - run: cargo +1.95 build --locked --lib --features cache
      - run: cargo +1.95 build --locked --lib --features __internals
      - run: cargo +1.95 build --locked --lib --all-features
      - run: cargo +1.95 build --locked --lib --features compact
      - run: cargo +1.95 build --locked --lib --features compact,cache
      - run: cargo +1.95 test --locked --test api --test no_alloc --test tiny_inputs --test public_properties --test bitcoin_core --test owned_output --features std
        env:
          PROPTEST_CASES: '512'
      - run: cargo +1.95 test --locked --test api --test no_alloc --test tiny_inputs --test public_properties --test bitcoin_core --test owned_output --features cache
        env:
          PROPTEST_CASES: '512'
      - run: cargo +1.95 test --locked --test api --test no_alloc --test tiny_inputs --test public_properties --test bitcoin_core --test owned_output --features std,compact
        env:
          PROPTEST_CASES: '512'
      - run: cargo +1.95 test --locked --test api --test no_alloc --test tiny_inputs --test public_properties --test bitcoin_core --test owned_output --features cache,compact
        env:
          PROPTEST_CASES: '512'

  package:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - run: cargo +stable package --locked
      - run: python3 scripts/check_package.py target/package

  pointer_width_32:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      PROPTEST_CASES: '512'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - run: sudo apt-get update
      - run: sudo apt-get install -y gcc-multilib
      - run: rustup target add --toolchain stable i686-unknown-linux-gnu
      - run: cargo +stable test --locked --target i686-unknown-linux-gnu --features __internals --lib --tests
      - run: cargo +stable test --locked --target i686-unknown-linux-gnu --features __internals,cache --lib --tests

  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - run: rustup component add clippy --toolchain stable
      - run: rustup component add rustfmt --toolchain stable
      - run: python3 scripts/check_ci_tests.py
      - run: python3 scripts/test_process_supervisor.py
      - run: python3 scripts/test_kani_guard.py
      - run: python3 -B -m unittest discover -s scripts -p test_custom_miri.py -v
      - run: cargo +stable fmt --all -- --check
      - run: cargo +stable fmt --manifest-path tools/resource-profile/Cargo.toml --all -- --check
      - run: cargo +stable fmt --manifest-path fuzz/Cargo.toml --all -- --check
      - run: cargo +stable clippy --locked --lib -- -D warnings
      - run: cargo +stable clippy --locked --lib --features std -- -D warnings
      - run: cargo +stable clippy --locked --lib --features cache -- -D warnings
      - run: cargo +stable clippy --locked --lib --features __internals -- -D warnings
      - run: cargo +stable clippy --locked --lib --all-features -- -D warnings
      - run: cargo +stable clippy --locked --lib --features compact -- -D warnings
      - run: cargo +stable clippy --locked --lib --features std,compact -- -D warnings
      - run: cargo +stable clippy --locked --lib --features cache,compact -- -D warnings
      - name: Public and internal API documentation
        env:
          RUSTDOCFLAGS: -D warnings
        run: cargo +stable doc --locked --no-deps --all-features

  measurement_tools:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        cache_args: ['', '--features cache']
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - run: cargo +stable test --locked --release --manifest-path tools/resource-profile/Cargo.toml ${{ matrix.cache_args }}
      - run: cargo +stable test --locked --release --manifest-path tools/resource-profile/Cargo.toml --features count-allocations ${{ matrix.cache_args }}
      - run: cargo +stable run --locked --release --manifest-path tools/resource-profile/Cargo.toml ${{ matrix.cache_args }} -- self-check
      - run: cargo +stable run --locked --release --manifest-path tools/resource-profile/Cargo.toml --features count-allocations ${{ matrix.cache_args }} -- self-check
      - run: cargo +stable test --locked --release --manifest-path tools/resource-profile/Cargo.toml --features compact ${{ matrix.cache_args }}
      - run: cargo +stable test --locked --release --manifest-path tools/resource-profile/Cargo.toml --features compact,count-allocations ${{ matrix.cache_args }}
      - run: cargo +stable run --locked --release --manifest-path tools/resource-profile/Cargo.toml --features compact ${{ matrix.cache_args }} -- self-check
      - run: cargo +stable run --locked --release --manifest-path tools/resource-profile/Cargo.toml --features compact,count-allocations ${{ matrix.cache_args }} -- self-check
      - run: python3 scripts/resource_report.py self-test
      - run: python3 scripts/cache_tradeoffs.py --self-test
      - run: python3 scripts/code_size.py --self-test
      - run: python3 scripts/backend_summary.py --self-test
      - run: python3 scripts/setup_clang23.py --self-test
      - run: python3 scripts/run_native_sanitizer.py --self-test
      - run: python3 scripts/check_ci_tests.py --self-test
      - run: python3 scripts/benchmark_graphs.py --self-test
      - run: python3 scripts/compare_threshold.py --self-test
      - run: python3 scripts/ac_power_run.py --self-test
      - run: python3 assets/graphs/render.py --check
      - run: python3 scripts/verify_power.py --self-test
      - run: python3 -m py_compile scripts/validate_wasm_tradeoffs.py
      - run: node --check scripts/code_size_wasm.mjs
      - run: node --check scripts/wasm_tradeoffs.mjs
      - run: node --check scripts/wasm_allocations.mjs

  wasm_measurement_abi:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - run: rustup target add --toolchain stable wasm32-unknown-unknown
      - run: rustup component add --toolchain stable llvm-tools
      - run: cargo +stable fetch --locked --manifest-path tools/resource-profile/Cargo.toml
      - name: Build checked and prevalidated benchmark exports
        env:
          RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN: stable
        run: >-
          python3 scripts/code_size.py --source .
          --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/base58-wasm-abi" --target wasm32-unknown-unknown
          --cpu generic --kinds cdylib
          --backends auto,bs58,five8,matrix-forced,ntt-same-owned,ntt-same-cached
          --strip-tool "$(rustc --print sysroot)/lib/rustlib/x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/bin/llvm-strip"
      - name: Verify Wasm pointer, UTF-8 and output contracts
        run: node scripts/code_size_wasm.mjs "$RUNNER_TEMP"/base58-wasm-abi/*.wasm.stripped
      - name: Counted Wasm allocator contracts for both policies
        env:
          RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN: stable
        run: |
          python3 scripts/code_size.py --source . --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/base58-wasm-allocations-default" --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --cpu generic --backends empty,auto,no-alloc --directions both --kinds cdylib --count-allocations --strip-tool "$(rustc --print sysroot)/lib/rustlib/x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/bin/llvm-strip"
          node scripts/wasm_allocations.mjs --self-test "$RUNNER_TEMP/base58-wasm-allocations-default"
          python3 scripts/code_size.py --source . --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/base58-wasm-allocations-cache" --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --cpu generic --backends empty,auto,no-alloc --directions both --kinds cdylib --count-allocations --strip-tool "$(rustc --print sysroot)/lib/rustlib/x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/bin/llvm-strip" --cache
          node scripts/wasm_allocations.mjs --self-test "$RUNNER_TEMP/base58-wasm-allocations-cache"
      - name: Refuse counted modules in the timing driver
        run: |
          for cache_policy in default cache; do
            if node scripts/wasm_tradeoffs.mjs --self-test "$RUNNER_TEMP/base58-wasm-allocations-$cache_policy" --backends empty,auto,no-alloc > "$RUNNER_TEMP/wasm-counted-rejection-$cache_policy.log" 2>&1; then
              cat "$RUNNER_TEMP/wasm-counted-rejection-$cache_policy.log"
              exit 1
            fi
            grep -F 'timing requires uninstrumented modules' "$RUNNER_TEMP/wasm-counted-rejection-$cache_policy.log"
          done

  miri_supported:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    env:
      RUSTFLAGS: -C target-cpu=x86-64 -C target-feature=+avx2
      MIRIFLAGS: -Zmiri-strict-provenance
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - run: rustup toolchain install nightly-2026-10-26 --component miri --profile minimal
      - run: cargo +nightly-2026-10-26 miri setup --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
      - run: |
          set -e -o pipefail
          cargo +nightly-2026-10-26 miri test --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu --locked --features __internals --test miri 2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/miri-supported-buffers.log"
          grep -Eq '^test result: ok\. 5 passed; 0 failed; 14 ignored;' "$RUNNER_TEMP/miri-supported-buffers.log"
      - run: |
          set -e -o pipefail
          cargo +nightly-2026-10-26 miri test --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu --locked --test tiny_inputs 2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/miri-supported-tiny.log"
          grep -Eq '^test result: ok\. 2 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored;' "$RUNNER_TEMP/miri-supported-tiny.log"
      - run: |
          set -e -o pipefail
          cargo +nightly-2026-10-26 miri test --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu --locked --lib miri_tests:: 2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/miri-supported-core.log"
          grep -Eq '^test result: ok\. 3 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored;' "$RUNNER_TEMP/miri-supported-core.log"
      - run: |
          set -e -o pipefail
          cargo +nightly-2026-10-26 miri test --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu --locked --lib matrix::x86::tests::kernels_match_portable -- --exact 2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/miri-supported-avx2.log"
          grep -Eq '^test result: ok\. 1 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored;' "$RUNNER_TEMP/miri-supported-avx2.log"
      - name: Alternate alias model and seed
        env:
          MIRIFLAGS: -Zmiri-strict-provenance -Zmiri-tree-borrows -Zmiri-seed=1
        run: |
          set -e -o pipefail
          cargo +nightly-2026-10-26 miri test --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu --locked --lib miri_tests:: 2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/miri-supported-tree.log"
          grep -Eq '^test result: ok\. 3 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored;' "$RUNNER_TEMP/miri-supported-tree.log"

  miri_arm_panel:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    env:
      RUSTFLAGS: -C target-cpu=generic
      MIRIFLAGS: -Zmiri-strict-provenance
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - run: sudo apt-get update
      - run: sudo apt-get install -y gcc-aarch64-linux-gnu
      - run: rustup toolchain install nightly-2026-10-26 --component miri --profile minimal
      - run: cargo +nightly-2026-10-26 miri setup --target aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu
      - run: |
          set -e -o pipefail
          cargo +nightly-2026-10-26 miri test --target aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu --locked --lib matrix::neon::tests::panel_matches_portable -- --exact 2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/miri-arm-panel.log"
          grep -Eq '^test result: ok\. 1 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored;' "$RUNNER_TEMP/miri-arm-panel.log"
      - run: |
          set -e -o pipefail
          cargo +nightly-2026-10-26 miri test --target aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu --locked --features __internals,malachite-nz/32_bit_limbs --test miri forced_encoder_leaves -- --exact 2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/miri-arm-forced-leaves.log"
          grep -Eq '^test result: ok\. 1 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored;' "$RUNNER_TEMP/miri-arm-forced-leaves.log"

  miri_custom:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 90
    env:
      CARGO_BUILD_JOBS: '1'
      CARGO_INCREMENTAL: '0'
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        arch: [arm, x86]
        cache:
          - { name: 'off', args: '' }
          - { name: 'on', args: '--cache' }
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          repository: elichai/miri
          ref: 52a3791566bfb72b99a59058527a3fcf6d38afa2
          path: .custom-miri-source
      - if: matrix.arch == 'arm'
        run: sudo apt-get update
      - if: matrix.arch == 'arm'
        run: sudo apt-get install -y gcc-aarch64-linux-gnu
      - run: rustup toolchain install nightly-2026-10-26 --profile minimal
      - name: Pinned compiler installer
        run: >-
          cargo +nightly-2026-10-26 install --locked
          rustup-toolchain-install-master --version 1.12.2
          --root "$RUNNER_TEMP/custom-miri-installer"
      - name: Matching compiler in an isolated Rustup home
        run: |
          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/custom-miri-rustup/toolchains"
          RUSTUP_HOME="$RUNNER_TEMP/custom-miri-rustup" "$RUNNER_TEMP/custom-miri-installer/bin/rustup-toolchain-install-master" --channel nightly --name custom-miri-df87fa660 -c rust-src -c rustc-dev -c llvm-tools -- df87fa6604e33760d4703cccc777a2281bf15a2d
      - name: Build reviewed development interpreter
        run: |
          compiler=$(RUSTUP_HOME="$RUNNER_TEMP/custom-miri-rustup" rustup run custom-miri-df87fa660 rustc --print sysroot)
          pinned_cargo=$(rustup which --toolchain nightly-2026-10-26 cargo)
          python3 scripts/build_custom_miri.py --source .custom-miri-source --compiler "$compiler" --cargo "$pinned_cargo" --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/custom-miri-build"
      - name: All SIMD probes, kernels and named buffer cases
        run: >-
          python3 scripts/run_custom_miri.py
          --build-record "$RUNNER_TEMP/custom-miri-build/build.json"
          --source . --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/custom-miri-all"
          --target-dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/custom-miri-target"
          --arch ${{ matrix.arch }} --alias-model tree --seed 1 --suite all
          ${{ matrix.cache.args }}
      - name: Alternate alias model and seed for actual kernels
        run: >-
          python3 scripts/run_custom_miri.py
          --build-record "$RUNNER_TEMP/custom-miri-build/build.json"
          --source . --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/custom-miri-alternate"
          --target-dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/custom-miri-target"
          --sysroot "$RUNNER_TEMP/custom-miri-all/sysroot"
          --arch ${{ matrix.arch }} --alias-model stacked --seed 7 --suite kernels
          ${{ matrix.cache.args }}
      - name: Compact IFMA kernels with Tree Borrows
        if: matrix.arch == 'x86'
        run: >-
          python3 scripts/run_custom_miri.py
          --build-record "$RUNNER_TEMP/custom-miri-build/build.json"
          --source . --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/custom-miri-compact-tree"
          --target-dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/custom-miri-target"
          --sysroot "$RUNNER_TEMP/custom-miri-all/sysroot"
          --arch x86 --alias-model tree --seed 1 --suite kernels --compact
          ${{ matrix.cache.args }}
      - name: Compact IFMA kernels with Stacked Borrows
        if: matrix.arch == 'x86'
        run: >-
          python3 scripts/run_custom_miri.py
          --build-record "$RUNNER_TEMP/custom-miri-build/build.json"
          --source . --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/custom-miri-compact-stacked"
          --target-dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/custom-miri-target"
          --sysroot "$RUNNER_TEMP/custom-miri-all/sysroot"
          --arch x86 --alias-model stacked --seed 7 --suite kernels --compact
          ${{ matrix.cache.args }}
      - name: Retain custom interpreter records and artifacts
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: custom-miri-${{ matrix.arch }}-${{ matrix.cache.name }}
          path: |
            ${{ runner.temp }}/custom-miri-build/build.json
            ${{ runner.temp }}/custom-miri-build/source.json
            ${{ runner.temp }}/custom-miri-build/build-*.log
            ${{ runner.temp }}/custom-miri-build/target/debug/miri
            ${{ runner.temp }}/custom-miri-build/target/debug/cargo-miri
            ${{ runner.temp }}/custom-miri-all/run.json
            ${{ runner.temp }}/custom-miri-all/*.log
            ${{ runner.temp }}/custom-miri-alternate/run.json
            ${{ runner.temp }}/custom-miri-alternate/*.log
            ${{ runner.temp }}/custom-miri-compact-tree/run.json
            ${{ runner.temp }}/custom-miri-compact-tree/*.log
            ${{ runner.temp }}/custom-miri-compact-stacked/run.json

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - if: matrix.arch == 'arm'

  fuzz:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 60
    env:
      CARGO_INCREMENTAL: '0'
      CARGO_BUILD_JOBS: '2'
      CXXFLAGS: -fsanitize=${{ matrix.sanitizer }} -fno-omit-frame-pointer
      ASAN_OPTIONS: abort_on_error=1:detect_stack_use_after_return=1:detect_leaks=1
      LSAN_OPTIONS: exitcode=23
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - { sanitizer: address, cache_args: '', label: default }
          - { sanitizer: address, cache_args: '--features cache', label: cache }
          - { sanitizer: leak, cache_args: '', label: default }
          - { sanitizer: leak, cache_args: '--features cache', label: cache }
          - { sanitizer: address, cache_args: '--features compact', label: compact }
          - { sanitizer: address, cache_args: '--features cache,compact', label: cache-compact }
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - run: sudo apt-get update
      - run: sudo apt-get install -y g++-12 libz3-4 libxml2 libedit2 libffi8 libzstd1 zlib1g
      - run: rustup toolchain install nightly-2026-10-26 --component rust-src --profile minimal
      - name: Matching LLVM toolchain
        run: python3 scripts/setup_clang23.py --prefix "$RUNNER_TEMP/clang23"
      - run: cargo install --locked cargo-fuzz --version 0.13.2
      - run: |
          python3 fuzz/test_seed_corpus.py
          python3 fuzz/seed_corpus.py
      - name: Careful build with instrumented standard library
        run: >-
          cargo +nightly-2026-10-26 fuzz build --careful --build-std
          --sanitizer ${{ matrix.sanitizer }} --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
          --no-default-features ${{ matrix.cache_args }}
      - name: Runtime bootstrap
        run: |
          cargo +nightly-2026-10-26 fuzz run --careful --sanitizer ${{ matrix.sanitizer }} --no-default-features ${{ matrix.cache_args }} encode_all fuzz/corpus/encode_all/pattern-32 -- -runs=1 -timeout=120 -rss_limit_mb=4096
          cargo +nightly-2026-10-26 fuzz run --careful --sanitizer ${{ matrix.sanitizer }} --no-default-features ${{ matrix.cache_args }} decode_all fuzz/corpus/decode_all/carry-32 -- -runs=1 -timeout=120 -rss_limit_mb=4096
      - name: Mutations
        run: |
          cargo +nightly-2026-10-26 fuzz run --careful --sanitizer ${{ matrix.sanitizer }} --no-default-features ${{ matrix.cache_args }} encode_all fuzz/corpus/encode_small -- -max_len=8193 -len_control=0 -max_total_time=180 -timeout=120 -rss_limit_mb=4096
          cargo +nightly-2026-10-26 fuzz run --careful --sanitizer ${{ matrix.sanitizer }} --no-default-features ${{ matrix.cache_args }} decode_all fuzz/corpus/decode_small -- -max_len=8193 -len_control=0 -max_total_time=180 -timeout=120 -rss_limit_mb=4096
      - name: Complete boundary corpus replay
        run: |
          cargo +nightly-2026-10-26 fuzz run --careful --sanitizer ${{ matrix.sanitizer }} --no-default-features ${{ matrix.cache_args }} encode_all -- -runs=0 -max_len=65537 -timeout=120 -rss_limit_mb=4096
          cargo +nightly-2026-10-26 fuzz run --careful --sanitizer ${{ matrix.sanitizer }} --no-default-features ${{ matrix.cache_args }} decode_all -- -runs=0 -max_len=89502 -timeout=120 -rss_limit_mb=4096
      - name: Full-width native NTT mutations
        if: matrix.sanitizer == 'address' && (matrix.label == 'default' || matrix.label == 'cache')
        run: |
          set -e -o pipefail
          python3 fuzz/check_mutations.py --self-test
          rustc +nightly-2026-10-26 --edition=2024 --test fuzz/full_width.rs -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/base58-full-width-tests"
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/base58-full-width-tests"
          mkdir -p fuzz/artifacts/encode_full_width
          cargo +nightly-2026-10-26 fuzz run --careful --sanitizer address --no-default-features --features full-width${{ matrix.label == 'cache' && ',cache' || '' }} encode_full_width fuzz/corpus/encode_full_width -- -max_len=8193 -len_control=0 -max_total_time=180 -print_corpus_stats=1 -print_final_stats=1 -seed=1 -timeout=120 -rss_limit_mb=4096 2>&1 | tee fuzz/artifacts/encode_full_width/campaign.log
          python3 fuzz/check_mutations.py fuzz/artifacts/encode_full_width/campaign.log > fuzz/artifacts/encode_full_width/mutation-stats.json
      - name: Retain corpus and failures
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: fuzz-${{ matrix.sanitizer }}-${{ matrix.label }}
          path: |
            fuzz/corpus
            fuzz/artifacts
          if-no-files-found: ignore
          retention-days: 14

  fuzz_coverage:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 45
    env:
      CARGO_INCREMENTAL: '0'
      CARGO_BUILD_JOBS: '2'
      RUSTFLAGS: -Zextra-const-ub-checks -Zstrict-init-checks --cfg careful
      CXXFLAGS: -fno-omit-frame-pointer
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        cache_args: ['', '--features cache']
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - run: sudo apt-get update
      - run: sudo apt-get install -y g++-12 libz3-4 libxml2 libedit2 libffi8 libzstd1 zlib1g
      - run: rustup toolchain install nightly-2026-10-26 --component llvm-tools-preview --profile minimal
      - run: python3 scripts/setup_clang23.py --prefix "$RUNNER_TEMP/clang23"
      - run: cargo install --locked cargo-fuzz --version 0.13.2
      - run: |
          python3 fuzz/test_seed_corpus.py
          python3 fuzz/seed_corpus.py
      # Source coverage uses prebuilt std; careful sanitizer builds run separately.
      - name: Replay boundaries and report source coverage
        run: |
          llvm_dir="$(rustup run nightly-2026-10-26 rustc --print sysroot)/lib/rustlib/x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/bin"
          for target in encode_all decode_all; do
            cargo +nightly-2026-10-26 fuzz coverage --sanitizer none --debug-assertions --strip-dead-code=false --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu --target-dir target/coverage --no-default-features ${{ matrix.cache_args }} --jobs 1 "$target" "fuzz/corpus/$target" -- -timeout=120 -rss_limit_mb=4096
            "$llvm_dir/llvm-cov" report "target/coverage/x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/release/$target" -instr-profile="fuzz/coverage/$target/coverage.profdata" '-ignore-filename-regex=/(registry|rustc|rustlib)/|/fuzz/|/tests/' > "fuzz/coverage/$target/report.txt"
            "$llvm_dir/llvm-cov" export "target/coverage/x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/release/$target" -instr-profile="fuzz/coverage/$target/coverage.profdata" --summary-only '-ignore-filename-regex=/(registry|rustc|rustlib)/|/fuzz/|/tests/' > "fuzz/coverage/$target/summary.json"
          done
      - name: Retain coverage records
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: fuzz-coverage-${{ matrix.cache_args == '' && 'default' || 'cache' }}
          path: fuzz/coverage
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 14

          - { sanitizer: memory, cache: 'off', compact_args: '', label: memory-off }
          - { sanitizer: memory, cache: 'on', compact_args: '', label: memory-on }
          - { sanitizer: memory, cache: 'off', compact_args: '--compact', label: memory-off-compact }
          - { sanitizer: memory, cache: 'on', compact_args: '--compact', label: memory-on-compact }
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - run: sudo apt-get update
      - run: sudo apt-get install -y g++-12 libz3-4 libxml2 libedit2 libffi8 libzstd1 zlib1g

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - run: cargo install --locked kani-verifier --version 0.68.0
      - run: cargo kani setup
      - run: sudo apt-get update
      - run: sudo apt-get install -y z3
      - name: Tiny production paths and alphabet domains
        run: python3 scripts/kani_guard.py -- sh scripts/kani-production.sh
      - name: Two-digit batched decoder
        # SAT avoids Kani 0.68's SMT-lowering failure for this harness.
        env:
          CARGO_BUILD_JOBS: '1'
          CARGO_INCREMENTAL: '0'
          CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_OPT_LEVEL: '3'
        run: >-
          python3 scripts/kani_guard.py -- cargo kani --lib --exact
          --harness verification::two_digit_batched_decoding_matches_radix_and_capacity
          -Z function-contracts -Z stubbing -Z unstable-options
          --harness-timeout 360s --output-format regular --solver cadical
      # Wider experimental obligations have separate documented timeout results.
      - run: >-
          python3 scripts/kani_guard.py -- cargo kani --lib --harness ntt::proofs:: --harness matrix::proofs::
          --harness validity_matches_digit_table --harness leading_zero_split_is_exact
          --harness partial_chunk_matches_horner --harness two_limb_
          --harness wrapped_fold_preserves_residue --harness one_limb_production_multiply
          --harness carry_preserves_radix52_columns --harness encode_batched_reduce_is_exact
          --harness radix52_unpack_pack_roundtrip --harness div3_recovers_quotient_with_carry
          --harness single_update_matches_wide_reference --harness single_limb_update_matches_wide_reference
          --harness encoded_capacity_never_panics
          --harness full_chunk_invalid_rejection --harness digit_table_has_only_valid_values_or_sentinel
          -Z function-contracts -Z stubbing -Z unstable-options --harness-timeout 180s --jobs 2 --output-format terse
      - name: Parser and capacity mathematical lemmas and compositions
        # Kani 0.68's optimized MIR can omit a contract closure on x86 Linux.
        env:
          CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_OPT_LEVEL: '0'
        run: >-
          python3 scripts/kani_guard.py -- cargo kani --lib --solver z3 --harness encoded_capacity_covers_input
          --harness encoded_capacity_endpoint_saturates --harness capacity_formula_lemma
          --harness verification::ten_digit_split_identity_lemma
          --harness verification::digit_range_lemma
          --harness encode::verification::capacity_affine_step_lemma
          --harness encode::verification::capacity_shift_clamp_step_lemma
          --harness encode::verification::capacity_at_product_lemma
          --harness encode::verification::encoded_capacity_adjacent_monotonicity_at_products
          --harness api::capacity_proofs::decoded_capacity_bounds_every_usize
          --harness api::capacity_proofs::decoded_capacity_is_within_one_byte_of_ceil47
          --harness api::capacity_proofs::decoded_capacity_prefix_sum_never_overflows
          -Z function-contracts -Z stubbing -Z unstable-options --harness-timeout 180s --jobs 2 --output-format terse
          --cbmc-args --external-smt2-solver scripts/kani-z3-polynomial.sh
      - name: Composed production parser and paired-update status
        env:
          CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_OPT_LEVEL: '0'
        run: >-
          python3 scripts/kani_guard.py -- cargo kani --lib --exact --solver cadical
          --harness verification::full_chunk_numeric_pipeline_composed
          --harness batched::proofs::paired_update_all_return_success
          -Z function-contracts -Z stubbing -Z unstable-options
          --harness-timeout 180s --output-format terse

      - name: IFMA scalar obligations with compact windows
        run: >-
          python3 scripts/kani_guard.py -- cargo kani --lib --features compact --solver cadical
          --harness carry_preserves_radix52_columns --harness radix52_unpack_pack_roundtrip
          --harness one_limb_production_multiply
          -Z function-contracts -Z stubbing -Z unstable-options
          --harness-timeout 180s --output-format terse
